name: Beautiful Machines
source:
Pascal Rosso, a worker at Sinley's Factory, will become involved in strange and macabre events while uncovering the truth behind their cryptic boss and the cold walls of their workplace.

[From [url=https://micropajaro.itch.io/beautiful-machines]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
辛利工厂的工人帕斯卡·罗索将卷入奇怪而可怕的事件，同时揭开神秘老板和工作场所冰冷墙壁背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://micropajaro.itch.io/beautiful-machines]Itch.io[/url]]
